what: The Magnum Ice Cream Company is Unilever's ice cream business, spun off as a separate listed company in 2025. It owns Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Wall's, Cornetto and Breyers.
customers: Supermarkets, corner shops and ice cream vans worldwide, and consumers buying by brand.
money: tubs and multipacks sold through supermarkets
single servings sold from freezer cabinets in shops and kiosks
moat: Freezer cabinets. The company places and owns freezers in hundreds of thousands of shops, and whoever owns the cabinet decides what is in it.
risks: A 3.7% net margin and 39 times earnings: a newly separated company still carrying spin-off costs
$4.0B of debt taken on at the separation
Ice cream demand is weather-dependent and summers vary
opportunities: Revenue grew from $8.3B to $9.3B last year
Magnum and Ben & Jerry's are premium brands that can hold price increases
As a standalone company the business gets management attention and capital it never had inside Unilever
watch: Volume growth separate from price, and the margin as spin-off costs fall away.
